Upstream.//ClientApplicationName: Defaults to OpcUaExporter so an existing certificate store, whose certificate is CN=OpcUaExporter and is already trusted by the upstream server, keeps working. Change it only when issuing a new certificate and trusting it upstream.

Acquisition.//Mode: Subscription lets the server report changes and is much cheaper for both ends. Polling reads every tag on a timer, for servers whose subscription support is absent or unreliable.

Server.//Host: Left empty to use this machine's host name, which must match the server certificate for secure endpoints to validate.
Server.//Port: 4841 rather than 4840, so the bridge can run alongside an OPC UA server already on this machine.
Server.//PreserveNamespaceIndexes: Mirror each namespace at the index it had upstream, so downstream clients with a literal 'ns=N;...' NodeId configured keep working.
Server.//StaleAfterSeconds: How long a cached value stays UncertainLastUsableValue during an outage before degrading to BadNoCommunication.

Snapshot.//CaptureOnFirstRun: Off by design. Capturing the namespace is an operator decision, not something the service should do to itself because a file was missing.

Web.//Urls: Loopback only by default. Binding anywhere else requires an AdminToken, or the service refuses to start.
